source.title: New Hope Open Winter 2019 on January 20, 2019 in New Hope, Pennsylvania, United States
source.content: The [New Hope Open Winter 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewHopeOpenWinter2019) will take place on January 20, 2019 in New Hope, Pennsylvania, United States. Check out [New Hope Open Winter 2019 website](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewHopeOpenWinter2019)  for more information and registration.

translation.title: New Hope Open Winter 2019 将于 1 月 20 日在美国宾夕法尼亚州纽霍普举行
translation.content: [New Hope Open Winter 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewHopeOpenWinter2019) 将于 2019 年 1 月 20 日在美国宾夕法尼亚州纽霍普举行。更多信息及报名方式请见 [New Hope Open Winter 2019 比赛页面](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewHopeOpenWinter2019)。
